text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11,000 ft. The pilot monitoring read back 11,000 ft and the pilot flying set 11,000 ft and climbed, with the aircraft climbing through 10,019 ft to 11,044 ft and 11,228 ft. Crosscheck stayed silent, which was right because the clearance, the readback and the setting agreed.
